column1: # Readings of words the rules read wrong: Latin words and brands, abbreviations. Tab-separated: the word in lower case
# (Latin or Cyrillic, a hyphenated word as one: "wi-fi"), its reading in Russian letters with '+' before the stressed
# vowel. Other Latin words are transliterated, capitals of up to three letters are read letter by letter.
